changelog: Board column headers explain their stage behind an info icon (hover and keyboard focus) (#3660). New optional `PipelineStage.description` (VarChar 280): curated, localized descriptions for the sales funnel template, or the admin's own text from the stage editor shown verbatim — the label rule of #2268. On the FREE plan it is part of the locked look (`onlyGatesChanged`).

en: Each board column now has an info icon that explains what the stage means; admins can write their own text in the stage editor.
tr: Pano sütunlarında artık aşamanın ne anlama geldiğini açıklayan bir bilgi ikonu var; yöneticiler kendi açıklamalarını aşama düzenleyicisinden yazabiliyor.
de: Jede Board-Spalte hat jetzt ein Info-Symbol, das erklärt, was die Phase bedeutet; Admins können im Phasen-Editor eigene Texte hinterlegen.
